title: 14 特殊的惊骇的救人方式15 厉害杰作
content_zh:
庶女的生存法则
玲珑吓得腿软，连滚带爬地想逃命，眼看就要丧命刀下，如情又捡了个石头扔了过去，打中对方的肩膀，那人抬头，凶光瞪向如情，如情不顾一切捡起石头就往他身上招呼，也不知打中没，那人身手挺矫健的，如情的石头几乎都没打中，这时候已提着刀朝如情走来。如情又朝他扔了个石头，那人抬臂挡掉了，如情忽然朝他身后欣喜叫道：“哥哥，快拿箭射他。”那人下意识转头，见身后并没什么人，正待疑惑，忽然耳朵一阵剧痛，原来如情又扔了石头，这回打中耳朵，痛得他几乎断了气，这回是彻底被激怒了，哇哇大叫着提着刀冲向如情。如情吓得赶紧往水里跑去。
她没有游过泳，但知道憋气，也知道双手双腿要像鱼一样摆动，她跳下水里后，被灌了不少水，刚开始还能保持镇定，伸展着四肢划了几下，身子果真浮了起来，可惜她没能憋住气，鼻子里又灌了不少水，又沉了下去，她也想保持镇定，继续伸展四肢，但这次却力不从心，口鼻已灌了不少水，好难受，渐渐地，身子往湖底沉去，她拼命地挣扎着，原来溺水的滋味真不好受……
正当如情以为她要被淹死时，蓦地，身子被一个强有力的手给拖了起来，紧接着，她吸到了新鲜空气。这时候的她，偿还有些意识，见被人救了起来，全身上下忽然发泄了气的皮球，再也使不出劲来，只能由着好心人把她拖到岸上来。
如情上得岸，吐了不少的水，沉香玲珑忙连滚带爬上前连声问侯。
三月的天气，还是有很冷的凉意的，全身湿淋淋的如情被冷风一吹，只觉牙齿都在打颤，不过好在小命保住了，不幸中的大幸，她呛出了肚子里大半的水后，这才回答道：“没事，就是呛了些水。你们呢？有没有伤着哪？”
沉香心有余悸地道：“还多亏了靖王爷及时赶到，一箭射死了那个坏人。不然，奴婢就真要与姑娘天人相隔了。”
玲珑也一脸怕怕地道：“是呀，真的好险。还多亏了靖王爷。”
如情一听原来是李骁救了自己，心里也挺感动的，正四处找李骁的身影，正想好生感谢人家，只是四处瞧了瞧，“咦，李骁人呢？”
其他王府的护卫一听这话立马齐齐变了色，其中一人望了湖面，蓦地大叫：“糟了，王爷还没上岸来。”紧接着几个扑通声，几个护卫已下了水去捞人了。
如情也一脸紧张地望着湖面，在心里祀悼李骁千万别有事，如果因为救自己反把他的命搭进去，她一辈子良心不安说，也无法向靖王府交差了。
王府的护卫水性还不错，很快就把李骁救了起来，可惜，这时候的李骁，已是冷冰冰毫无反应了。如情吓得一个激灵，连滚带爬地爬到李骁身边，可惜还没爬过去，护卫们已团团把李骁围住，纷纷一个劲儿地压李骁的肚子。
连压了好些时候，李骁嘴里鼻里冒出了水来，但仍是晕迷不醒着，这下子，其他护卫已傻了眼，一副天下榻下来的模样，“怎么办？王爷是不是已经……”一个看起来年纪比较轻的护卫已吃吃地道。
另一个年纪大些的护卫怒吼一声：“胡说，王爷吉人自有天相，不会有事的。王爷，王爷……”然后那名护卫疯了似地死命按李骁的肚子。
如情这时候也是心慌不已，见状也顾不得其他，命令他们：“救人哪是这样救的，还不快把他翻过来。”
其他人愣愣地瞪着他，一时间不知该作何反应。
如情急了，瞪眼道：“还愣着做甚？快把他翻过来。我来救他。”
众人哪会相信一个小姑娘能救人，但这时候，也就死马当作活马医，把李骁翻了过来，如情爬上前去，一边按着他的胸膛，一边颤抖着手，捏着他的双唇，缓缓附下身子，往李骁冰冷的唇里渡气。
蓦地，一阵尖锐的抽气声响来……如情充耳不闻，继续深呼吸了下，又往李骁嘴里渡气。
所幸李骁溺水还不算太久，只是一时憋了气，但如情仍是累得够呛，一直持续了一盏茶的时光，总算发现李骁的胸口有了起伏，这才狠狠舒了口气，继续往李骁嘴里渡气，待李骁开始咳嗽后，这才一屁股跌坐到地上，不知是累的，还是被吓的。

等如情终于回过神后，这才发现众人双眼瞪自己如铜铃，不由面色发红，强自镇定：“你们瞪我做甚？我这还不是为了救人嘛？对了，今天的事儿，不许对外人说一个字，明白吗？”如情觉得，二十一世纪，对男人做人工呼吸也没啥的，但这是古代呀，男女授受不亲，连见个面都不能随易相见的时代，众目睽睽下来个人工呼吸，也难怪会让他们全都石化。但没法以子，如果李骁因为救她而死，她也脱不了责，说不定还会连累方家。不得已之下，只能如此了。
王府里的护卫们僵硬着点头，如情又严厉道：“你们可得仔细考虑清楚。我已经定了婚事，你们可得管紧了自己的嘴巴。今日本姑娘用这种方式救你们王爷，要是传扬出去，对我，对李骁，都没好处。所以，都给我把嘴巴捂严实了。若有一个字传出去，害我被向家退婚，我铁定要你们王爷对我负责。”
众人连忙点头，纷纷表示不会说出去一个字。
如情又道：“包括李骁，千万别让他知道是我救的……你们就说是我救了他，但千万别说我是用……这种方式救的他，明白吗？”她要让李骁知道，她方如情虽然养在深闺，但救人还是有一套的，少那么瞧不起人。
content_en:
The survival rules of a concubine
Linglong was so frightened that her legs went weak and she crawled on the ground trying to escape. She was about to be killed by the knife. Ruqing picked up another stone and threw it, hitting the opponent's shoulder. The man raised his head and glared at Ruqing. Ruqing desperately picked up the stone and threw it at him. She didn't know whether it hit him or not. The man's hands were very strong. Ruqing's stone almost didn't hit him. At this time, he was walking towards Ruqing with a knife. Ruqing threw another stone at him, but the man raised his arm to block it. Ruqing suddenly shouted happily behind him: "Brother, take an arrow and shoot him." The man turned his head subconsciously and saw that there was no one behind him. Just as he was wondering, he suddenly felt a sharp pain in his ear. It turned out that Ruqing had thrown another stone. This time, it hit the ear, and the pain made him almost lose his breath. This time, he was completely irritated. He yelled and rushed towards Ruqing with a knife. Ruqing was so frightened that she quickly ran into the water.
She had never swum before, but she knew how to hold her breath, and knew how to swing her hands and legs like a fish. After she jumped into the water, she was given a lot of water. At first, she could remain calm, stretched her limbs and paddled a few times, and her body really floated. Unfortunately, she couldn't hold her breath, and the feeling in her nose She poured a lot of water and sank again. She also wanted to stay calm and continue to stretch her limbs, but this time she was unable to do so. A lot of water had been poured into her mouth and nose, which made her feel uncomfortable. Gradually, her body sank to the bottom of the lake. She struggled desperately. It turned out that the feeling of drowning was really unpleasant...
Just when Ruqing thought she was going to drown, suddenly, her body was dragged up by a strong hand, and then she breathed in fresh air. At this time, she still had some consciousness. Seeing that she was rescued, her whole body was suddenly deflated. She could no longer exert her strength, so she had to be dragged to the shore by kind people.
Ruqing came to the shore and vomited a lot of water. Agarwood Linglong hurriedly rolled up and climbed forward to greet her.
The weather in March was still very cold. She was wet all over and felt the cold wind blowing through her body. She felt her teeth chattering. Fortunately, her life was saved. Fortunately, she choked out most of the water in her stomach. Then she replied: "It's okay, I just choked on some water. What about you? Are you injured?"
Chen Xiang said with lingering fear: "Thanks to Prince Jing who arrived in time and shot the bad guy to death with one arrow. Otherwise, the slave and the girl would have been separated from each other."
Linglong also looked frightened and said: "Yes, it's really dangerous. Thanks to Prince Jing."
Ruqing was very moved when she heard that it was Li Xiao who saved her. She was looking for Li Xiao everywhere and wanted to thank him, but she just looked around and said, "Hey, where is Li Xiao?"
Upon hearing this, the other guards of the palace immediately changed their expressions. One of them looked at the lake and suddenly shouted: "Oh no, the prince hasn't come ashore yet." Following a few splashes, several guards had already entered the water to fish people out.
Ruqing also looked at the lake with a nervous look on her face, praying in her heart that nothing would happen to Li Xiao. If he took his life because of saving her, she would have uneasy conscience for the rest of her life and would not be able to report to Prince Jing's Mansion.
The guards of the palace were pretty good and quickly rescued Li Xiao. Unfortunately, at this time, Li Xiao was cold and unresponsive. Ruqing was so frightened that she crawled to Li Xiao's side. Unfortunately, before she could crawl over, the guards surrounded Li Xiao and pressed down on Li Xiao's stomach.
After pressing for a long time, water came out of Li Xiao's mouth and nose, but he was still unconscious. At this time, the other guards were dumbfounded and looked like they were lying down. "What should I do? Is the prince already..." A guard who looked younger had already said.
Another older guard roared angrily: "Nonsense, Prince Jiren has his own destiny, everything will be fine. Prince, Prince..." Then the guard pressed Li Xiao's stomach like crazy.
Ruqing was also flustered at this time and could not care less when she saw the situation.Others, ordered them: "This is how you save people, why don't you turn him over quickly."
The others stared at him blankly, not knowing how to react.
Ruqing became anxious and glared: "Why are you still standing there? Turn him over quickly. I'll save him."
No one would believe that a little girl could save people, but at this time, they turned Li Xiao over, Ruqing climbed forward, pressed his chest, pinched his lips with trembling hands, slowly lowered her body, and breathed into Li Xiao's cold lips.
Suddenly, there was a sharp gasping sound... Ruqing turned a deaf ear to it, continued to take a deep breath, and breathed into Li Xiao's mouth again.
Fortunately, it didn't take long for Li Xiao to drown, and he was just holding his breath for a moment, but Ruqing was still very tired. After a cup of tea, he finally found that Li Xiao's chest was rising and falling, and then he breathed a sigh of relief and continued to breathe into Li Xiao's mouth. After Li Xiao started coughing, he fell to the ground. I don't know if he was tired or frightened.
After Ruqing finally came back to her senses, she realized that everyone was glaring at her like bells. She couldn't help but turn red, and tried to calm down: "Why are you staring at me? Isn't this just to save people? By the way, you are not allowed to say a word to outsiders about what happened today. Do you understand?" ?" Ruqing felt that in the 21st century, it was okay to perform artificial respiration on men, but this was an ancient era, when men and women were not close to each other and could not even meet each other easily. It is no wonder that artificial respiration in front of everyone would turn them all to stone. But she couldn't help it. If Li Xiao died trying to save her, she wouldn't be able to escape responsibility, and he might even bring trouble to the Fang family. As a last resort, this is the only way.
The guards in the palace nodded stiffly, and said affectionately and sternly: "You have to think carefully. I have already decided to get married, and you have to keep your mouth shut. If the Japanese girl saved your prince in this way today, it will not be good for me or Li Xiao if it spreads. So, please keep your mouth tightly closed. If a word gets out and my engagement is annulled by the Xiang family, I will definitely hold your prince responsible for me."
Everyone nodded quickly and expressed that they would not say a word.
Ruqing added: "Including Li Xiao, please don't let him know that I saved him... Just say that I saved him, but don't say that I saved him in this way, understand?" She wanted Li Xiao to know that although she, Fang Ruqing, was raised in a boudoir, she still had her own way of saving people and should not look down on them so much.
